instruction: Cinematic film still, medium shot. Inside a dimly lit boxing ring with hanging punching bags, the woman in the black and orange sports top (R1) stands on the left, facing right. She holds a red focus mitt with her left hand, her right gloved hand held near her chest. The woman in the white sports bra (R2) stands on the right, back partially to the camera, extending her right arm to land a punch with her black glove onto the red mitt. Cool overhead gym lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows.
